name: comp-132
title: Simple Checkbox
blurb: Checkbox with associated label for simple boolean input.
description: Pre-built checkbox with label demonstrating proper form labeling. Uses shadcn Checkbox and Label components with matching IDs.
use_when: Quick checkbox setup in forms without custom styling.
avoid_when: Repetitive use—build a wrapper component instead.
a11y: Checkbox and label properly associated via id/htmlFor. Full keyboard and screen reader support.
